q: 第二版三元组枚举最贴近哪种算法模式？

options: 对所有牌做 DFS 回溯，穷举到游戏结束
固定一个位置，用哈希表在剩余牌里找补数配对
随机抽三张牌，直到凑巧命中目标和
每个点数只保留第一张牌，丢弃其余重复牌
why: 3-sum 思路把内层查找转成哈希补数查询，从 O(n^3) 降到 O(n^2)。这只是加速枚举，不自动改善选择质量。

options_en: Run DFS backtracking over all cards, exhausting the game tree to the end.

Randomly draw three cards until they happen to hit the target sum.

对，固定一个数、用哈希表查另一个数是不是在场上，正是经典 3-sum 套路，把内层查找从线性扫描降到近似 O(1)。
随机抽三张牌命中目标和只是碰运气，没有稳定的复杂度保证，不算算法模式。

q: 第二版用什么评分思想避免选坏三元组？

options: 选位置编号最小的那个合法三元组
只挑点数最大的三张牌，凑够目标和就行
模拟移除该三元组后，统计剩余网格还能形成多少个三元组
永远优先选包含「目标和的一半」这个点数的牌
why: 一层 lookahead 用“移除后选择空间有多大”衡量当前移动好坏。结构上正确，但位置空间实现太慢。
why_en: One-step lookahead scores a move by how many triples remain after removing it.
whenOtherWins: 如果运行时间极紧且只需通过小测试，不评分的 first-found 更短更简单。
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Moves[Legal triples] --> Sim[Remove one triple]
  Sim --> Count[Count remaining triples]
  Count --> Rank[Pick highest score]
options_en: Pick the legal triple with the smallest position index.
Just pick the three highest-value cards that still sum to the target.
Simulate removing the triple and count how many triples the remaining grid can still form.
Always prefer a triple that includes a card worth half the target sum.
tradeoff: 评估移除后剩余选择空间 vs 只看当前这一步是否合法

termDefinitions.meaning: 在真正执行一个候选移动前，先模拟它的后果并打分，用来比较哪个候选更好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lookahead simulates a candidate move's consequences and scores it before committing, so candidates can be compared.

optionExplanations: 选位置编号最小的三元组只是决定性的 tie-break 顺序，跟这个三元组本身好不好没有关系。
只挑点数最大的三张牌是一种简单启发式，但没有模拟后果，仍可能孤立掉别的关键牌。
对，先假装移除这个三元组，再数剩余局面还剩几个三元组，剩得越多说明这步棋对后续越友好。
偏爱包含「目标和一半」点数的牌只是碰巧对某些目标和有效的猜测，不是通用评分规则。

Right — simulate removing the triple, then count how many triples the remaining board still supports; more remaining means a friendlier future position.

q: 为什么 3-sum 加位置级 lookahead 会超时？
q_en: Why does 3-sum plus position-level lookahead time out?
scenario: 10x10 满盘约 2500 个候选三元组，测试 30 秒超时；3-sum 已经把枚举本身降到 O(n^2)。
scenario_en: A full 10x10 board yields about 2500 candidate triples, the test times out at 30 seconds, and 3-sum has already cut enumeration itself to O(n^2).
options: 哈希表这种数据结构本身无法用来存储整数值
所有候选三元组排序时使用的键并不稳定
目标和 39 定得太小，导致几乎凑不出候选三元组
每个候选移除后都要在近百个位置上重新统计三元组
why: 满棋盘约有 2500 个合法候选，每个候选再做 O(n^2) 统计。真正的瓶颈是候选评分循环。
why_en: The positional lookahead times out because every candidate triggers another large positional enumeration.
options_en: A hash map as a data structure simply cannot store integer values.
The sort key used to order all candidate triples is unstable.
Target sum 39 is set too small, so almost no candidate triples exist.
Removing each candidate forces a fresh triple count over nearly a hundred positions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用键直接定位值的数据结构，平均下插入和查找都是 O(1)。

optionExplanations: 错，哈希表存整数是最基本的用法，这不是瓶颈所在。
错，排序键是否稳定只影响并列结果的顺序，不会造成超时。
错，目标和 39 在 25 个点数值域下候选相当充足，约 2500 个候选正说明并不稀缺。

Wrong — sort-key stability only affects tie-break order; it can't cause a timeout on its own.
Wrong — target sum 39 still leaves plenty of candidates in a 25-value domain; about 2,500 candidates shows it isn't scarce.
Right — the cost isn't finding candidates, it's rescoring each one over nearly a hundred positions; multiplying that by candidate count is the real bottleneck.

q: 3-sum 枚举加位置级评分的每回合复杂度为什么是 O(n^4)？

每回合都要把整个棋盘复制出 O(2^n) 份来做穷举
候选排序这一步本身的复杂度就已经是 O(n^4)
目标和检查这一步本身的复杂度就已经是 O(n^4)
why: 候选数量和候选评分都在位置空间里随 n^2 增长。相乘就是 n^4。
why_en: Quadratic candidate generation times quadratic rescoring yields quartic work per turn.
scenario: 3-sum 枚举给出 O(n^2) 个候选三元组，每个候选又要在剩余局面上做一次 O(n^2) 的重新统计。

options_en: O(n^2) candidates times an O(n^2) rescoring pass for each one.
Every turn copies the whole board into O(2^n) separate states for exhaustive search.
Sorting the candidates by itself already costs O(n^4).
Checking the target sum by itself already costs O(n^4).

Wrong — there's no exponential state copying here; n^4 is polynomial growth, nothing like 2^n.

q: 位置空间和点数直方图空间在这个题里的关键差异是什么？
q_en: What is the key difference between position space and value-histogram space in this problem?
scenario: 优化局有 100 个位置但点数只有 1-25 共 25 种，合法性只看点数和，评分必须在 30 秒内跑完。
scenario_en: The optimization board has 100 positions but only 25 distinct values from 1 to 25, legality depends only on the value sum, and scoring must finish within 30 seconds.
options: 直方图这种表示方式根本没法表达点数重复出现多次的情况
位置空间有 100 个位置状态，直方图只压缩到 25 个点数桶
位置空间这种表示方式本身就不允许真正执行一次移动
换成直方图表示后会导致目标和的数值也跟着一起变化
why: 求和规则只看点数，同点数不同位置在评分时可以互换；直方图保留了选择质量需要的信息（点数库存），丢掉的是评分不需要的冗余位置身份。
why_en: Since the sum rule only cares about values, positions sharing a value are interchangeable for scoring, so the histogram keeps exactly what scoring needs and drops redundant positional identity.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  P[100 positions] -->|compress by value| H[25 value buckets]
  H --> Score[Fast value scoring]
  H --> Pos[Value to positions]
  Pos --> Move[Real move]
options_en: A histogram representation simply cannot express a value that repeats multiple times at all.
Position space has 100 position states; the histogram compresses that down to 25 value buckets.
Position space as a representation does not, by itself, allow actually playing a move.
Switching to a histogram representation would also change the target sum's own value.
tradeoff: 状态空间大小（100 个位置 vs 25 个点数桶） vs 是否保留位置身份信息

termDefinitions.meaning: 按值分桶计数的数组，例如 hist[8] 记录点数为 8 的牌还剩几张。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A histogram is a value-indexed count array, e.g. hist[8] tracks how many cards of value 8 remain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把每个点数映射到拥有该点数的所有实体牌位置的列表，用来在选定点数后取回真实坐标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pos_by_value maps each card value to the list of grid positions holding that value, used to recover real coordinates once a value triple is chosen.

optionExplanations: 直方图正是靠计数表达重复：hist[8]=3 就表示还有三张点数 8 的牌，重复值没被丢掉，只是换了记法。
对，100 个位置压成 25 个点数桶，状态规模缩到约四分之一，这也是后面评分能变快的根本原因。

目标和是引擎里的固定常量，换任何表示都不会让它变化，这个选项混淆了表示和规则。
optionExplanations_en: A histogram represents duplicates exactly via counts — hist[8]=3 means three cards of value 8 remain; nothing about repeats is lost, only how it's recorded.
Right — compressing 100 positions into 25 value buckets shrinks the state to roughly a quarter of the size, exactly why scoring gets cheaper downstream.
Position space can obviously still play a move — the real issue is it carries positional identity that scoring doesn't need, which slows down repeated enumeration.
The target sum is a fixed engine constant; switching representations never changes it — this option confuses representation with rules.

scenario: 游戏评分只依赖牌的点数和数量，同点数不同花色在选择三元组时可以互换。
scenario_en: Scoring depends only on card values and counts, and cards with the same value but different suits are interchangeable when choosing triples.
q: 最合适的优化表示是什么？
q_en: What is the best optimized representation?
options: 把每个位置序列化成字符串后逐一暴力比较

按点数建计数直方图，同时保留点数到位置列表的映射
只保留牌堆最上面那一张牌的信息
why: 直方图让枚举和评分在 25 个点数桶上完成，位置列表只在真正执行移动时使用。它把问题压到必要状态。
why_en: A value histogram captures scoring structure while position lists let the final move call use actual coordinates.
whenOtherWins: 如果规则包含位置奖励、相邻约束或花色约束，纯点数直方图可能丢掉必要信息。

Build a 100x100 matrix indexed by position coordinates.
Build a value-count histogram, plus a value-to-positions map for later lookup.
Keep only the information for the single top card of the deck.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把每个点数映射到拥有该点数的所有实体牌位置的列表，用来在选定点数后取回真实坐标。

optionExplanations: 把位置序列化成字符串再逐一比较，既没有压缩状态也没有加速查找，反而比直接算点数和更慢。

Right — a value histogram runs enumeration and scoring on just 25 buckets, while the pos_by_value map recovers actual coordinates only when a move is played.

q: histogram lookahead 每回合复杂度用 V 表示是哪一项？

options: O(V)

v2 == v3（后两个相同）时，用 hist[v1] * C(hist[v2], 2)
why: 重复值需要组合数，不同值之间直接相乘；三值全同时应该用 C(count,3) 这类组合公式，而不是布尔式的加 1，否则会低估这个点数密集时能组成的三元组数量。
why_en: Repeated values need combination counts and distinct values simply multiply; treating v1==v2==v3 as a flat +1 instead of a C(count,3)-style combination undercounts how many triples a dense value actually supports.
options_en: When all three values differ, use hist[v1] * hist[v2] * hist[v3].
When v1 == v2 == v3, just add 1.
